prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that at the Petersons' potluck, you presented a store-bought dish in your own cookware. Respond to the committee.
response:
I am here today to address these allegations directly and honestly.

I did not present a store-bought dish in my own cookware at the Petersons' potluck. What I brought was a homemade casserole, prepared from scratch in my own kitchen, using my late mother's recipe. I transported it in my own casserole dish, as is customary and, I believe, entirely proper.

If the committee is referring to the fact that the dish was store-bought *brand* cookware, then yes, I purchased it at a retailer. I did not forge the ceramic myself. I stand by that.

If the committee is insinuating that the potato salad I brought was from a deli, I reject that characterization. I boiled those potatoes. I chopped those pickles. I wept dicing those onions. I have nothing to hide.
